strings.lang.intro: Izilimi ezikhulu sezifakiwe. Layisha ulimi lwakho ukuze uthole ukuhunyushwa okugcwele ngaphandle kwe-intanethi — izincazelo, iziganeko nezinye izinto.
strings.lang.failed: Ukulayisha kwehlulekile. Hlola ukuxhumana bese uzama futhi.
strings.settings.night.desc: Ubomvu ojulile uvikela amehlo azejwayeze ubumnyama — ukukhanya kobomvu akuphazamisi kakhulu ukubona ebusuku, isibhakabhaka siyaqhubeka ukukhanya.
strings.settings.night.auto.desc: Iguquka ibe nbomvu ngokuzenzakalelayo uma isibhakabhaka siba mnyama ngemuva kokushona kwelanga.
strings.settings.location.cityNone: Akutholakalanga — uhlu olwakhelwe ngaphakathi lunamadolobha amakhulu angaba ngu-5,300, ngakho amadolobhana amancane awekho.
strings.settings.location.cityNearest: Khetha idolobha elikhulu eliseduze: ngaphakathi kwe-~50 km isibhakabhaka sibonakala sifana.
strings.settings.location.cityGps: Noma sebenzisa i-GPS — idivayisi yakho ithola indawo eqondile, kudivayisi ngokwayo
strings.settings.location.cityCoords: Noma sesha izinombolo zendawo yakho eqondile
strings.pro.freeCore: Ingxenye eyisisekelo izohlala imahhala unomphela — ikhamera, iLanga, iNyanga kanye nawo wonke amaplanethi ayi-7. I-Pro inweba nje uhlu bese yengeza amathuluzi ambalwa engeziwe.
strings.pro.lifetimeDesc: Ukuthenga kanye. Ngaphandle kwesikhathi esimisiwe — ngeke iphele noma ivuselelwe.
strings.settings.speech.desc: Iqinisekisa inhloso neziqondiso ngezwi — ukusetshenziswa ngaphandle kwezandla nabantu abangaboni.
strings.settings.fov.desc: Lungisa kancane ukuze imigqa yamaqoqo nezindlela zamasathelayithi zifane nesibhakabhaka sangempela.

strings.paywall.subtitle: Thenga kanye. Akukho nkontileka, akukho akhawunti — elakho kuze kube phakade, ogcwele ngaphandle kwe-intanethi.

strings.ev.equinoxSub: Imini nobusuku kuseduze nokulingana — ilanga liphuma empumalanga ngqo futhi lishone entshonalanga ngqo
strings.ev.supermoonSub: Inyanga ephelele eseduze kunazo zonke onyakeni — inkulu futhi ikhanya kancane kunokujwayelekile
strings.ev.blueMoonSub: Inyanga ephelele yesibili kule nyanga — igama nje, ayiluhlaza ngempela

strings.settings.identifyLines.desc: Idweba imigqa exhumanisa izinkanyezi zeqembu ngalinye lezinkanyezi elibonakala. Ungakwazi futhi ukuvula nokuvala ngqo ngaphakathi "Yini leyo?" ngenkinobho 👁.
strings.sat.launched: Yethulwa ngo-{year} · ngokuphakama okungaba ngu-{km} km
strings.sat.desc.iss: Isakhiwo esikhulu kunazo zonke esihlala abantu emkhathini. Ithimba labahambi bomkhathini lihlala kulo njalo, futhi lizungeza umhlaba cishe kanye nemizuzu engu-92. Ngokuvamile kuyipoyinti elikhanya kakhulu eledlula esibhakabhakeni ebusuku.
strings.sat.desc.css: Isiteshi samkhathini saseChina, esihlala abantu kusukela ngo-2021. Simncane kunesiteshi Samkhathini Samazwe Omhlaba, kodwa lapho sedlula kahle sikhanya ngalinganayo.
strings.sat.desc.hst: Isibonakude samkhathini esethulwa ngo-1990 esashintsha okwesaziyo ngendawo yonke. Sathatha izithombe zezingqungquthela zezinkanyezi ezikude ngempela futhi sasiza ukulinganisa ukuthi indawo yonke yanda ngayiphi isivinini.
strings.sat.desc.acs3: Isathelayithi yokuhlola yeNASA enomkhumbi welanga ocishe ube ngu-80 m², ugqilazwa kuphela yingcindezi yokukhanya kwelanga. Umkhumbi wayo okhanyayo wenza ikhanye ngobukhulu bayo.
strings.sat.desc.envisat: Isathelayithi yaseYurophu yokuqapha umhlaba, ebukhulu obufana nebhasi. Ukuxhumana nayo kulahlekile ngo-2012, futhi kusukela ngaleso sikhathi ihlale isezungeza njengeyinye yezingqinamba ezinkulu zodoti lwasemkhathini.
strings.sat.desc.amos: Uchungechunge lwamasathelayithi okuxhumana lwase-Israel. Asobukhulu obucishe bube ngu-36,000 km, ngakho abonakala angafuzi ukunyakaza endaweni eyodwa esibhakabhakeni. Ayibonakali ngamehlo nqu, kodwa uhlelo lusibonisa indlela abheke kuyo.
strings.sat.desc.eros: Isathelayithi yase-Israel yezithombe ezinekhwalithi ephezulu, isebenza yiImageSat, yethulwa ngo-2022.
strings.sat.desc.venus: Isathelayithi yocwaningo yase-Israel-France eyethulwa ngo-2017 ethatha izithombe zezitshalo nezindawo zokulima ukulandela izinguquko zemvelo.
strings.sat.desc.cat.weather: Isathelayithi yesimo sezulu edlula ngaphezulu kwamapholo. Ithatha izithombe zamafu, iziphepho, nokushisa, futhi idatha yayo isiza ukubikezela kwesimo sezulu.
strings.sat.desc.cat.observation: Isathelayithi ethatha izithombe zomhlaba — amahlathi, amadolobha, ulwandle, nomkhenkce — ukuze ilandele indlela aguquka ngayo ngesikhathi.
strings.sat.desc.cat.science: Isathelayithi eyakhelwe ukucwaninga umkhathi noma umhlaba. Amanye awo awasasebenzi, kodwa aseselokhu asezungeza.
strings.sat.desc.cat.telescope: Isibonakude samkhathini esibheka indawo yonke ngaphezulu komkhathi, umunca ingxenye enkulu yokukhanya okuvela emkhathini.
strings.sat.desc.cat.communication: Isathelayithi edlulisela umabonakude, i-inthanethi, nezingcingo. Iningi lawo lindiza phezulu kakhulu, ngakho amehlo nqu abona ambalwa kuphela.
strings.sat.desc.cat.starlink: Elinye lamasathelayithi eStarlink angaphezu kwezinkulungwane eSpaceX, anikeza i-inthanethi evela emkhathini. Andiza phansi, ngakho kulula ukuwabona, futhi ngesinye isikhathi adlula ngomugqa omude, ngalinye ngemuva kwelinye.
strings.sat.desc.cat.rocket: Ingxenye engaphezulu yerokhethi, eyathwala isathelayithi ezungeza kwayo futhi yasala khona ngayo uqobo. Lezi zinto zinkulu futhi zivame ukukhanya, ngakho kulula ngandlela ethile ukuzibona.
strings.identify.proMore: IPro iphinde ibonakalise zonke izinkanyezi, amaqembu ezinkanyezi, nezinto zomkhathi ojulile.
strings.tonight.hint: Izikhathi lapho into ngayinye iphezulu kwesibhakabhaka namuhla ebusuku · thinta ukuqondisa ikhamera kuyo
